stem.text: An isolated object of negligible weight is acted on by two coplanar forces of the same magnitude.
In which diagram is the object in equilibrium?

A.alt: Grey square with one arrow pointing down onto its top edge and one arrow pointing up from below its bottom edge.

B.alt: Grey square with one arrow pointing down onto its top-left corner and one arrow pointing up from below its bottom-right corner.

C.alt: Grey square with two arrows pointing up from below its bottom edge.

D.alt: Grey square with one arrow pointing down onto its top edge and one horizontal arrow pointing left onto its bottom-right corner.
